description:
Hey there, I’m Max 👋
I make simple, animated videos that explain how money really works — from budgeting and investing to building passive income and getting out of debt.

My goal is to take the stress out of learning finance by turning big, complicated ideas into clear, easy-to-follow stories you’ll actually enjoy watching.

If you’ve ever wondered how to grow your savings, manage your money better, or create new income streams, this channel is built for you.
Each episode blends education with entertainment, helping you understand finance one short animation at a time.

🔔 Subscribe for new videos every day — no jargon, no fluff, just simple insights for real financial freedom.

⚠️ Disclaimer: All content on this channel is for educational and entertainment purposes only and should not be considered financial, investment, or legal advice. Always do your own research or consult a qualified professional before making financial decisions.
